## About
The service center at Nalley Toyota Union City takes care of Toyota and Scion vehicles for drivers across the Atlanta area, including Union City, Jonesboro and Fayetteville. Whether it's a routine oil change or a larger repair, our technicians are factory-trained and work with Genuine Toyota Parts.
Our service advisors can walk you through maintenance intervals or a concern about how your car is running, and help you decide what it actually needs. Every service includes a complimentary multi-point inspection.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating from 1114 Google reviews. Stop by, or schedule your next visit online.

## Services
- Oil change: Regular oil changes using genuine Toyota Motor Oil and filters, synthetic or conventional, depending on what your vehicle requires.
- Toyota Express Maintenance: The routine basics done faster: oil change and filter, brake inspection, tire rotation, multi-point inspection and fluid inspection.
- Brake service and repair: Brake inspections and repairs. One reviewer had her rear brakes repaired and says there are no squeaks now.
- Tire replacement: Toyota tire replacement, plus an online tire store.
- Cabin and engine filter: Replacement of cabin and engine air filters.
- Check engine light: If your check engine light comes on, bring it in and our technicians will take a look.
- Parts ordering: Order parts for your vehicle through our parts center.

## FAQ
Q: Do you service Scion vehicles?
A: Yes. Your Scion will be cared for by trained technicians using Genuine Toyota Parts.

Q: How often does my Toyota need an oil change?
A: Most Toyotas in Union City need a synthetic oil change every 10,000 miles. A lot of idling in traffic can count as severe driving and call for more frequent changes, so ask us about your car.

Q: What happens during a multi-point inspection?
A: Our technicians check your battery, fluids and belts.

Q: Can I schedule service online?
A: Yes. Stop by, or schedule your next appointment online.

Q: Is service open on Saturday?
A: Yes, the service center is open Saturday from 7 AM to 5 PM.

Q: What if I need collision repair?
A: Nalley Collision Center Lithonia can help with collision repairs.
